name: Jorkeam
title: Descendant of Judah
summary: Jorkeam is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles in the genealogies of the tribe of Judah. He is listed as the son (or descendant) of Raham, who was the son of Shema. Jorkeam is primarily known through his place in the genealogy and has no other actions described in the Bible.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Judah's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jorkeam is listed in the genealogical register of the tribe of Judah as the son of Raham, son of Shema, in Caleb's line of descendants.

keyEvents.title: Caleb's Lineage
keyEvents.description: Jorkeam belongs to the extended lineage of Caleb (Caleb's son Mesha was the father of Ziph, and through several generations comes Jorkeam), which places him in an important branch of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Part of the History of the Tribe of Judah
keyEvents.description: As part of Judah's genealogy, Jorkeam helps document the spread and family branches of the tribe of Judah that were significant for Israel's history.

keyEvents.title: Genealogical Register of Chronicles
keyEvents.description: First Chronicles begins with extensive genealogies that connect the people of Israel from Adam onward, and Jorkeam is part of this grand picture.
